profile_text.body:
Capgemini is a public company whose website describes it as a global leader in consulting, technology services and digital transformation. It says it offers a range of integrated services that combine technology with deep sector expertise. The site carries the tagline "Make it real."

The site also highlights AI work, describing how AI is surfacing new match insights in real time to give fans a more complete and engaging view of the Rugby World Cup than before. No specific AI products, lawsuits, or other filings involving the company are recorded.
